name: Karmel Popcorn
subtitle: From Leslie, Mom’s longtime friend and nursing roommate

steps.title: Make the caramel
steps.body: Bring to boil in heavy pan, stirring: **3 sticks butter**, **¾ cup corn syrup**, **1¼ tsp salt** and **2 cups brown sugar**.

steps.title: Add soda and vanilla
steps.body: Remove from heat. Add and stir in: **¾ tsp soda** and **1½ tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Place on baking sheets, then bake at 250°F, stirring every 15 minutes.
